description: Adds two new ships, a halfbaked gameplay system, and four short missions. Includes mobile, upgradable battle colonies and interesting ships and weapons. Changes pirates to ask for your stuff instead of attacking immediately.
descriptionHtml: Adds two new ships, a halfbaked gameplay system, and four short missions. Includes mobile, upgradable battle colonies and interesting ships and weapons. Changes pirates to ask for your stuff instead of attacking immediately.
discordPostHtml:
after 9 years in development I return to you with 2 new ships, 1 halfbaked gameplay system and 4 short missions
making this a vanilla-quality mod

Main Features:

  • Mobile, upgradable battle colonies
  • Some interesting ships and weapons
  • Pirates now ask for your stuff instead of going for the throat straight up

If unsure about whether or not the mod is good just ask around in I'm sure they'll know.
